messages:
incident-bot: Deploy event: release/2026-03-15-connpinback-hotfix started (staged -> 20% traffic) at 2026-03-15T02:11:39Z
sara_ops: noticed p95 jump on /v1/generate at ~02:13. tails up to ~1.1s on certain hosts. paging oncall.
incident-bot: Page: @eva_oncall — high tail latency detected (p95 > 900ms for 5m). Priority=P1. See logs in thread.
eva_oncall: ack. been looking at recent deploys. @deploy-bot which rollout is in flight?
deploy-bot: rollout id=2026-03-15-connpinback-hotfix, initiated by @carlos_se, staged to 20% at 02:11:39Z
carlos_se: small change to socket pool pinning to reduce churn; shouldn't affect kernel selection but added an affinity hint.
mike_runtime: that hint might influence kernel routing. i'm seeing kernel_fallback spikes across the canary group starting 02:12:50.
ryan_sre: logs show batching_queue fragmentation + kernel_fallback=true entries coincident with spike. throughput for slice down ~18%.
sara_ops: error-rate up for long sequences >1024 tokens; 502s and timeouts seen in dashboards. customers reporting failures.
anne_support: support queue: acme-ads reported degraded latency and intermittent failures; betacorp reported timeouts. estimated customer impact ~10-15% traffic.
eva_oncall: mitigate fast: suggested plan: disable conn pinback flag for rollout selector, drain affected hosts, abort rollout if no recovery in 2m.
mike_runtime: agree. pinning forces routing to nodes with kernel variant mismatch; fallback disables optimized batching path.
sara_ops: executing feature flag flip now:
```
redwoodctl feature-flag set conn_pinback=false --env=prod --selector=rollout:2026-03-15-connpinback-hotfix
```
incident-bot: feature-flag change accepted at 2026-03-15T02:15:12Z
mike_runtime: queueing drains for affected host group:
```
redwoodctl runtime drain --group=connpin-canary-2026-03-15 --grace=20s
```
ryan_sre: started rolling restarts for 5/7 canary nodes to rebalance kernels.
sara_ops: p95 trending down toward baseline ~45s after flag flip. throughput partially recovered but some hosts still lagging.
carlos_se: recommending abort to avoid full rollout exposure — initiating abort.
eva_oncall: aborting rollout now:
```
deploy-bot abort rollout 2026-03-15-connpinback-hotfix --reason="kernel-fallback + tail latency"
```
deploy-bot: rollback started to release/2026-03-10-stable across canary hosts.
sara_ops: after rollback and drain, errors returned to baseline within ~3 minutes. p99 normalized shortly after.
anne_support: customer comms sent to impacted accounts (acme-ads, betacorp); offering incident summary and next steps.
mike_runtime: preliminary root cause: affinity hint in pool set_pin_strategy favored nodes with kernel variant A; some model families expected optimized kernel B. mismatch caused kernel_fallback -> fragmentation of batching -> degraded token throughput and increased latency for long gens.
ryan_sre: actions taken:
- feature-flag disabled
- canary rollout aborted and rollback executed
- drained/restarted affected nodes
- temporarily increased canary capacity to absorb rerouted traffic
- added monitoring for kernel_fallback ratios and batching_queue fragmentation
sara_ops: preparing handoff. eva, will hand over to RCA. capture deploy diff, kernel->model mapping, and affected host list.
eva_oncall: taking handoff. @mike_runtime and @carlos_se to own RCA write-up. @ryan_sre to produce remediation runbook for kernel-affinity changes. @anne_support to handle customer follow-ups.
mike_runtime: log snippet:
```
[02:12:50.112] host=host-07 kernel_hint=variantA pin=true batching_queue_size=2 kernel_fallback=true reason="compat_mismatch"
[02:12:51.678] host=host-07 req=... latency_ms=1089 batching_fragmentation=true
```
carlos_se: code diff that caused it:
```
- pool.set_pin_strategy("auto")
+ pool.set_pin_strategy("favor_local_kernel", timeout_ms=40)
```
sara_ops: post-incident lessons to add to postmortem:
- require kernel/model compatibility checks for affinity heuristics
- add long-seq synthetic smoke tests in canary
- add preflight kernel-variant audit before rollout
incident-bot: Post-incident ticket created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2170001111
mike_runtime: opened revert PR (PR#3489) to remove new pin_strategy and add guard rails. expedited review requested.
carlos_se: will add compatibility matrix tests and long-input smoke. apologies for the outage.
eva_oncall: closing oncall for now. monitor for 30m. will publish postmortem once RCA complete. good mitigation and comms, team. :raised_hands:
incident-bot: Incident resolved at 2026-03-15T02:18:59Z. Duration: ~7m. Severity: P1 -> mitigated. Postmortem assigned.
